summary: Final verification of the 3 target issues on Sistem Operasional UMKM. Results: (1) 'Sesi telah habis' toast on unauth visits to '/' and '/login' — FIXED (no longer appears). However a NEW/regression toast 'Gagal memuat statistik dashboard.' appears on unauth root '/' visit before the redirect to /login completes (DashboardTab useEffect fires a 401'd /dashboard/stats call during the loading→redirect window). (2) 'Pilih Paket Basic' hidden for Pro tenant — FIXED (data-testid=upgrade-pkg-btn-Basic not rendered; Pro card shows AKTIF badge). (3) Midtrans simulation upgrade (Basic→Pro via GOPAY/QRIS) — FIXED end-to-end: sidebar switches to 'PAKET PRO', WhatsApp tab becomes enabled, page reload persists the state, /api/auth/me returns tenant.package='Pro'.

ui_bugs.issue: When visiting '/' without a session, MainAppLayout correctly reads no cookie and calls navigate('/login'), but React first renders the child Routes with loading=false momentarily, letting DashboardTab mount and fire GET /api/dashboard/stats which 401s and triggers toast.error('Gagal memuat statistik dashboard.'). User sees a red error toast on the login screen. Fix: in the useEffect, do the navigate BEFORE (or without) setLoading(false), or gate rendering of children behind `currentUser` (not just !loading). Alternatively add an axios response interceptor that silently redirects on 401 without toasting.

action_items: Suppress the 'Gagal memuat statistik dashboard.' toast on unauth root visits. Recommended: guard MainAppLayout to only render <Routes/> when currentUser is set (else return spinner), so DashboardTab never mounts before /auth/me completes or redirect happens.
critical_code_review_comments: The Pro-upgrade rank check (getPkgRank at App.js:2039-2044) is correct and works — Pro tenant no longer sees Basic; Basic tenant sees only Pro. Consider hoisting the rank map to module scope and reusing it for future tier logic.
The auth guard added at App.js:390-398 correctly eliminates the 'Sesi telah habis' toast on cold visits. Good fix.

Midtrans simulation → window.location.reload() flow works because backend get_current_user still accepts the JWT via cookie. Ideal long-term: refresh via state (fetchAuthMe + fetchSubscription) instead of full reload.

New race condition surfaced: unauthenticated child components (DashboardTab) mount briefly and their 401 handlers show error toasts. Add a global axios interceptor that redirects to /login on 401 and swallows the toast when the user has no session.

success_rate.backend: not re-run (no backend changes to test)
success_rate.frontend: 3/3 target issues resolved; 1 new/regression toast surfaced on unauth root

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 target fixes are confirmed working. The only remaining issue is a new toast 'Gagal memuat statistik dashboard.' on unauth root visits caused by DashboardTab briefly mounting before the /login redirect. To reproduce: open incognito → visit '/' → observe red error toast on login screen. Root cause in App.js MainAppLayout useEffect (~L383-413): setLoading(false) is called before navigate, so the Routes tree renders once with children mounting. Fix by rendering children only when currentUser exists, or by adding a global 401 interceptor that navigates silently.
rca of the issue: MainAppLayout useEffect calls setLoading(false); navigate('/login'). React renders the intermediate state where loading=false but currentUser is null; the matched route inside MainAppLayout (default 'dashboard' tab) mounts DashboardTab whose useEffect fires GET /dashboard/stats → 401 → toast.error('Gagal memuat statistik dashboard.') before the navigate completes.
